title: US Weighs Restrictions on Cloud Computing to Curb China AI Chip Access
summary: The US Commerce Department is considering rules to restrict Chinese entities from remotely accessing high-performance AI chips in overseas data centers, targeting technology transfer via cloud. Rules expected before January 2027 and would affect Chinese cloud providers including Alibaba Cloud and Tencent Cloud that rely on overseas compute for AI workloads.
why: AI芯片管制是本轮最大宏观变量之一：若落地，阿里云/腾讯云/百度智能云的海外算力通路受阻，将倒逼更多本土化算力投入并重估相关港股/美股科技标的估值逻辑。本轮大盘头条偏少——NVDA CEO辞职（CNBC 11-13）、美国10月PPI（BLS 11-13）等主线已于上轮收录，今日（周日11-15）本条为唯一新增大盘级头条，当日大盘头条偏少。

title: EBA Begins Supervising USDC Under MiCA; BitGo Expands Institutional USDC Platform
summary: The European Banking Authority (EBA) commenced formal supervision of Circle's USDC on November 12, the first stablecoin designated as a significant e-money token under the EU's MiCA framework. Concurrently, institutional custodian BitGo announced expansion of its USDC minting and redemption platform for institutional clients.
why: EBA正式监管USDC标志欧洲稳定币合规基础设施成型，对Circle（CRCL）欧洲市场准入和机构级采用是长期利好，短期可能带来合规运营成本上升；BitGo扩容进一步验证机构对USDC需求，可关注USDC市场份额走势及对Tether的蚕食效应。
